entry.title: 🇳🇱 AI-enabled integrations with SAP Integration Suite (Utrecht, Netherlands)
entry.content:
In this SAP CodeJam, we will look at SAP Integration Suite and different AI features that we can leverage to integrate our systems and help improve our integration development activities. We will receive customer request events from a customer website, process them in SAP Cloud Integration with the help of an LLM hosted in SAP AI Core. Then, that information will be sent to the Customer service request system. Once we complete the integration flow we will get familiar with the new MCP Gateway available in API Management. We will expose an existing MCP server via the Gateway and we will create an MCP server for an existing API. To wrap things up, we will configure our new MCP server as tools available to an LLM and interact with them from a chat interface. By the end of the CodeJam, we will achieve a scenario like the one below in the diagram.

By the end of the CodeJam, we will achieve a scenario like the one below in the diagram.

 

Prerequisites

  • Bring your own laptop with power adapter and have a supported Web browser such as Google Chrome or Firefox installed on your laptop.
  • Check the full list of prerequisites here: https://github.com/SAP-samples/ai-enabled-integrations-codejam/blob/main/prerequisites.md 

Location and Date 

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Friday, September 18, 2026 from 13:00 - 19:00 local time in Utrecht, Netherlands (CEST). The language of the event and the content will be English.

Event Address: INNOV8iON, Boteyken 323, 3454 PD Utrecht, The Netherlands

  • The event is kindly being hosted by INNOV8iON – THANK YOU!
  • The instructor is SAP Developer Advocate Antonio Maradiaga

Please note that spaces are limited! We can only accommodate 30 attendees. If you want to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. About 2 weeks before the event, you will be asked to confirm your attendance and will receive further instructions.

entry.title: 🇪🇸 Real-time data for AI agents: Grounding with event-driven architecture (Barcelona, Spain)
entry.content:
This CodeJam introduces attendees to the power of event-driven integration pattern to deliver real-time grounding data, equipping AI system's with the latest business context to make informed and accurate decisions. We’ll explore how to apply real-time vector grounding by connecting structured data to an LLM using a vector database using SAP Integration Suite and SAP Integration Suite, advanced event mesh. You’ll see how updates to the data can instantly influence the model’s responses, keeping them current and contextually accurate.

Register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right on this page and register on Code10's webpage: SAP CodeJam Barcelona: Real-Time Data for AI Agents. The CodeJam is part of the Code10 TechTalks event. If you want to join the Code10 TechTalks taking place after the CodeJam, check out the details here: https://code10it.com/code10-techtalks-2026/ 

By the end of this session, you’ll achieve a scenario like the one on the screenshot below and understand the core principles behind real-time vector grounding, how to design an embedding strategy for structured entities, and how to integrate this into a sample AI workflow.

Currently, much of the session is based on the TechEd hands-on tutorials for IN162.

entry.title: 🔴 Supercharge Joule Desktop: Connect Any SAP API in Minutes with MCP Gateway
entry.content:
AI agents are transforming enterprise software, but they can't call SAP APIs the way developers do. They need tools: described, discoverable, and callable through a standardized protocol.

In this session we'll show how SAP Integration Suite's MCP Gateway and Joule Desktop close that gap end-to-end, without rebuilding your existing API investments.

We'll go through three progressive layers live:
- Layer 1: Connect: Use SAP Integration Suite's MCP Gateway to expose a real SAP S/4HANA APIs as an MCP Server with OAuth security and full governance in minutes.
- Layer 2: Orchestrate: Connect that MCP Server to Joule Desktop and build a Skill on top. Watch how a simple backend calls becomes a structured business output, powered by parallel sub-agents and contextual reasoning. The same data, a completely different result.
- Layer 3: Enterprise: Understand where Agent Gateway fits: the SAP-endorsed production path for governed, auditable, multi-agent access to SAP systems at scale.

By the end of the session you'll understand how the full stack fits together, you'll have seen it working live, and you'll know exactly where to start.

Who is this for: SAP developers, BTP architects, integration consultants, and anyone curious about how AI agents connect to enterprise systems. No prior MCP experience required.

All Devtoberfest 2026 slides are available here: https://dam.sap.com/mac/d/Agq9gge?sort=Alphabetical&rc=10

Javier Martin

entry.title: 🔴 Achieve Agentic Enterprise Automation with SAP Integration Suite and Joule Studio
entry.content:
Agentic automation needs more than isolated tools - it needs AI agents that can act on real enterprise data, across SAP and non-SAP systems, under real governance. In this deep-dive session, we show how Joule Studio and SAP Integration Suite work together to make that happen: you design and govern enterprise-grade AI agents in Joule Studio, while SAP Integration Suite provides the secure, scalable backbone that connects systems, orchestrates processes, and safeguards agentic AI scenarios. Through practical examples, a live demo, and customer success stories, you'll see how to combine agent design with enterprise-grade integration to build automations that stay controlled, observable, and measurable -moving from isolated automation to end-to-end intelligent process transformation.

This session includes:

- Where Joule Studio and SAP Integration Suite fit in SAP's Agentic Enterprise Automation framework
- Designing and governing enterprise-grade AI agents, grounded in your systems and data
- How SAP Integration Suite safeguards and scales agentic AI scenarios
- Measuring the value your agents deliver - plus a live demo and customer success stories

All Devtoberfest 2026 slides are available here: https://dam.sap.com/mac/d/Agq9gge?sort=Alphabetical&rc=10

Manuel Namyslo

Zeena Qarqash

entry.title: 🔴 Event Add-On for ERP: All you need to know about the new Event Studio
entry.content:
There is news in respect to the Event-Add On for ERP: Event Studio is essentially an improved, Fiori-based configuration and design environment within the Add-on. It allows SAP administrators and integration developers to define, configure, and manage business events directly inside the SAP system — without heavy custom ABAP development. Event Studio reduces implementation effort because it provides a low-code, configuration-based approach — and it provides ready-to-use content. Get a full tour of Event Studio including an extensive demo to get ready to use Event Studio yourself.

All Devtoberfest 2026 slides are available here: https://dam.sap.com/mac/d/Agq9gge?sort=Alphabetical&rc=10

Karsten Strothmann

Jakob Vogelsang

entry.title: 🔴 Your Agent Wants to Call SAP. Now What?
entry.content:
Every demo shows an agent calling SAP. Almost none of them show what sits in between.

That layer is where the interesting problems live. Which APIs do you actually expose, and to whom. What happens when the agent asks for a customer that exists three times under slightly different names. How do you keep an audit trail when the caller is a model instead of a person.

In this session Twan and Jan walk through the integration surfaces SAP gives you for agentic scenarios, where MCP fits, the gold paths, and where plain old process integration is still the right answer. Expect live builds, a few things that break, and an honest view of what is generally available today versus what is still on the roadmap.

Bring your questions about tool design, identity, and the parts nobody puts on a slide.

All Devtoberfest 2026 slides are available here: https://dam.sap.com/mac/d/Agq9gge?sort=Alphabetical&rc=10

Jan Penninkhof

Twan van den Broek

entry.title: 🔴 From opportunity to decision: Intelligent Credit Checks with AI Adapter in SAP Cloud Integration
entry.content:
What if a Salesforce opportunity could trigger more than just an integration flow? In this session, we’ll explore a real-world use case where a Salesforce opportunity triggers SAP Cloud Integration, which invokes SAP S/4HANA Credit Check APIs and uses the AI Adapter with an AI Sales Agent to evaluate credit information, business rules, and sales context. The AI Agent analyzes the credit history and recommends whether the opportunity should be approved, reviewed, or blocked, with the decision fed back into Salesforce for business users to act upon.

All Devtoberfest 2026 slides are available here: https://dam.sap.com/mac/d/Agq9gge?sort=Alphabetical&rc=10

Punith Oswal

entry.title: 🔴 From APIs to Agent Tools: How MCP Gateway changes what Integration means
entry.content:
AI agents are proliferating across enterprise landscapes — but without a governed entry point, every agent becomes a potential liability. The MCP Gateway is SAP Integration Suite's answer: a managed, trusted layer through which AI agents discover, authenticate against, and invoke enterprise capabilities, whether that is an SAP API, a third-party service, a composed service or a connected business process.

This session establishes why MCP Gateway is becoming the architectural centre-piece of agentic enterprise design. We will cover what MCP (Model Context Protocol) is, how SAP Integration Suite’s policy enforcement, and API-centric integration monitoring brings the qualities required for scaled, productive agents in enterprises, and why this needs to be a key focus as part of your integration strategy.

All Devtoberfest 2026 slides are available here: https://dam.sap.com/mac/d/Agq9gge?sort=Alphabetical&rc=10 

Arti Gopalan

Soumya Mukhopadhyay

entry.title: 🔴 MCP Gateway in Practice: Architecture, configuration, and hands-on
entry.content:
This session is about making it real. We will walk through the end-to-end process of exposing curated, enterprise APIs as governed MCP tools that AI agents can securely discover and invoke — configuring authentication, defining policy guardrails, testing agent connectivity, and validating that the right access controls hold under realistic conditions using the MCP Gateway in SAP Integration Suite,

This is a technical, hands-on session designed for architects and integration practitioners who are designing or building the integration layer for their agentic AI use cases.

Come with your questions. Leave with working knowledge.

All Devtoberfest 2026 slides are available here: https://dam.sap.com/mac/d/Agq9gge?sort=Alphabetical&rc=10

Palak Garg

Ashutosh Kumar Singh
